pr_title: Show selected end of line in TextEdit
pr_body:
Fixes #72265
Continues selection box at the end of line if eol/carriage return is selected.
Should be working well, works even with rtl text mixed in.
![2023-01-29 23-38-28](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1621768/215357592-78059e1c-e679-4f28-8650-8aad1c83053a.gif)
Also tested to be working with rtl mode.
pr_comments: Updated now. I changed from checking if layout direction is rtl to checking the text direction itself (since you could use right justification for ltr text too). However, I couldn't yet figure out how you can detect rtl text if `text_direction == TEXT_DIRECTION_AUTO`.

I think checking `if rtl` as before should be okay cc @bruvzg?

Otherwise looks good.

Okay, I'll change it back to `if (rtl)` then. End alignment is rarely needed anyway.

> The real end of line can be anywhere in the string, but for the selection purpose it's OK to add extra selection on the left/right side depending on alignment.

For reference, Microsoft Word also adds the end of line selection at the right side of text even if it's really at the center similiarly to this implementation.

Tested locally seems to leave a small gap, rtl looks good though:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6584330/218337269-86090310-a3af-4568-977c-964e8508396a.png)

Interesting. I can replicate that with certain line length and zoom level. Does this happen on every line on your setup?
I tested it on older build without `shaped_text_get_size`, it seems that it didn't occur then. (grab some older artifact here: https://github.com/aXu-AP/godot/actions?page=2)

I reverted back to using `shaped_text_get_selection` since `shaped_text_get_size` doesn't give perfect boundaries.
Sorry for leaving this for a month, my life just got quite busy for a moment 😅

I'm not a fan of having to loop over the entire line to draw the selection, might be worth looking at adding something to the `TextServer` to return exact rather then rounded `shaped_text_get_size`, or make it a `TextServer` behaviour?

One more try @Paulb23  😅
I looked into TextServer side of things but couldn't make head or tails of it. So I made a check if there's a subpixel gap between selections then it snaps to place. 

I should be a contender for the slowest contributor of the year, half a year for a simple fix and counting 🤣

Thanks, I really think this makes the script editor feel better, even if most won't notice the difference consciously.

Maybe somebody smarter will fix the underlying issue down the road. Should I open an issue for it so that it's documented? Something like: TextServer `shaped_text_get_size` and `shaped_text_get_selection` have subpixel differences.

> Maybe somebody smarter will fix the underlying issue down the road. Should I open an issue for it so that it's documented? Something like: TextServer `shaped_text_get_size` and `shaped_text_get_selection` have subpixel differences.

CC @bruvzg

> Maybe somebody smarter will fix the underlying issue down the road. Should I open an issue for it so that it's documented? Something like: TextServer shaped_text_get_size and shaped_text_get_selection have subpixel differences.

`shaped_text_get_size` is rounded up to ensure trimming will not cut part of string, `shaped_text_get_selection` is not, I'm not sure what's the best option to fix, I guess selection can be rounded up as well.
Wait, would it just work if we round up all selection rects? I'll do a test, just a moment.

@Paulb23 could you confirm that this solution works well and doesn't create visual problems with end of selection (as it might move the selection end by that one pixel in those cases)? I'm still hoping this to be part of 4.2 😊

I also improved on one existing comment 🤭

issue_context.title: Selection visual at end of the line inconsistent
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.beta.custom_build [3a25148b9], v3.5.1.stable.official [6fed1ffa3]

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Visuals for selected text in code editor has 2 flaws in it's logic. I think they're linked so this issue covers both (but I can split it into 2 separate issues if that's better).
First: If selection ends at empty line, carriage return _after the cursor_ is shown as selected:
![cr-start](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1621768/215282543-faa756d3-e6e8-47da-ba4d-68b79ff2e888.png)
> Above: Godot script editor, below: VS Code

Second: Carriage return at the end of selected lines is not shown (notice ambiguity - what happens if I press delete?):
![cr-end](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1621768/215283180-e2ac26cb-2376-47ab-bf21-92b7f886e0f8.png)
> Above: Godot script editor, below: VS Code

The behaviour seems to be consistent across other editors - I've tested on VS Code, Visual Studio and Notepad++

### Steps to reproduce

Open script editor and select text.

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
